Can never see a GP or get through to book appointment.  56 redials from 8 am to 8.39 am.   Finally got through to then speak to receptionist to be told gp would call me back.  To keep my phone clear until this happens. Don't get me started on being able to reorder medication.  No communication from practice to advice of new processes.   Annual review for Hugh blood pressure now have to do myself online.  When you question it just told NHS in crisis by a very abrupt and unsympathetic receptionist.   Yes we know that but why they in crisis?  Has a thorough evaluation of all the changes they've made been carried out to confirm better outcomes for these changes.  Early intervention/prevention definitely not a focus as per national and local strategic direction.

Today I changed my review to a 5 star from a 1 star given 3 weeks ago.

Well today I have had the pleasure of phoning the practice again.  I have to admit I had a better experience.   The Dr I spoke to today listened to me, offered options and was empathetic.   I actually felt better because she took it the time and was very patient even when I jumped from one topic to another.   I didn't feel rushed and now hope I get the same Dr if the option I have chosen doesn't work for me.   A huge thank you to this Dr for giving me faith back in my GP practice.   The receptionist was also helpful and friendly.
